1	
     2	# WP-006: Model Registry API Handlers, Routes, and API Client
     3	
     4	## Plan Context
     5	
     6	Implement configurable model settings for the persona system, replacing hardcoded YAML-only model configuration with a GUI-managed model registry and per-persona model assignment system.
     7	
     8	## Description
     9	
    10	Create the API handler module for model registry CRUD, assignment management, persona list, and persona rebuild — register all routes in the server, extend the API client, and add integration tests.
    11	
    12	## Scope
    13	
    14	- `mcp-server/gui/api-models.ts` — new API handler module
    15	- `mcp-server/gui/server.ts` — route registration (GET routes in `matchRoute()`, body-parsing routes in `handleRequest()`)
    16	- `mcp-server/gui/public/api-client.js` — new API client methods
    17	- `mcp-server/tests/gui/api-models.test.ts` — API handler integration tests
    18	
    19	## Deliverables
    20	
    21	- API handler functions: `handleGetModels()`, `handleSaveModels(body)`, `handleLoadDefaults()`, `handleGetAssignments()`, `handleUpdateAssignments(body)`, `handleReplaceAssignedModel(body)`, `handleGetPersonas()`, `handleRebuildPersonas(workspaceRoot)`
    22	- `handleSaveModels`: assigns UUIDv4 to entries missing `id`, delegates to `writeModels()`, returns 409 on referenced-model deletion
    23	- `handleGetAssignments`: enriches response with `stale` boolean (compares `max(mtime(assignments.json), mtime(local.json))` against `mtime(name-mapping.json)`; `default.json` excluded)
    24	- `handleUpdateAssignments`: validates model UUIDs exist in registry and persona keys are valid `id` values from `name-mapping.json`; returns 400 when `name-mapping.json` doesn't exist
    25	- `handleReplaceAssignedModel`: accepts `{ old_model_id, new_model_id }` UUIDs, validates both exist, rejects same-model replacement, replaces all occurrences
    26	- `handleGetPersonas`: reads `name-mapping.json`, returns empty array if file doesn't exist
    27	- `handleRebuildPersonas`: spawns `node scripts/build-personas.js`, module-level `buildInProgress` concurrency guard (409 on concurrent), returns success/failure with output
    28	- Route registration: 3 GET routes via `matchRoute()`, 5 body-parsing routes inline in `handleRequest()`
    29	- API client methods: `getModels`, `saveModels`, `loadDefaultModels`, `getPersonas`, `getAssignments`, `updateAssignments`, `replaceAssignedModel`, `rebuildPersonas`
    30	- Integration tests covering: bulk save lifecycle, UUID auto-generation, duplicate slug rejection, reserved slug rejection, slug-change stability, referenced-model deletion (409), unreferenced-model deletion, assignment validation (invalid persona ID, non-existent model UUID, missing `name-mapping.json`), load-defaults merge + conflict, replace-assigned-model (swap all, reject when not referenced, reject same-model), staleness detection (3 cases), persona list (exists/doesn't exist), rebuild persona (success, failure, concurrent guard, finally cleanup)
    31	
    32	## Dependencies
    33	
    34	- WP-002
    35	
    36	## Acceptance Criteria
    37	
    38	1. `GET /api/models` returns the model array, auto-initializing `local.json` from defaults on first access
    39	2. `PUT /api/models` auto-generates UUIDv4 for entries without `id` and persists all entries
    40	3. `PUT /api/models` with a duplicate slug returns a validation error
    41	4. `PUT /api/models` with reserved slug `"inherit"` on a non-sentinel entry returns a validation error
    42	5. `PUT /api/models` removing a referenced model returns 409 Conflict with a list of usages directing the user to the Replace Model feature
    43	6. `PUT /api/models` removing an unreferenced model succeeds
    44	7. `POST /api/models/load-defaults` merges defaults without overwriting existing entries and returns slug-collision conflicts
    45	8. `GET /api/model-assignments` returns assignments enriched with `stale: true` when `max(mtime(assignments.json), mtime(local.json))` > `mtime(name-mapping.json)`, `stale: false` when neither user file exists, and `stale: false` when only `default.json` is newer
    46	9. `PUT /api/model-assignments` validates model UUIDs exist in registry and persona keys exist in `name-mapping.json`; returns 400 when `name-mapping.json` doesn't exist
    47	10. `POST /api/model-assignments/replace` swaps all occurrences of `old_model_id` with `new_model_id`; rejects when `old_model_id` is not referenced (400); rejects when `old_model_id === new_model_id` (400 "Source and target models must be different")
    48	11. `GET /api/personas` returns all personas from `name-mapping.json` when it exists, or empty array when it doesn't
    49	12. `POST /api/personas/rebuild` spawns `node scripts/build-personas.js`, returns `{ success: true, output }` on exit 0 and `{ success: false, output, exitCode }` with HTTP 500 on failure
    50	13. `POST /api/personas/rebuild` returns 409 when a build is already in progress; clears the `buildInProgress` flag on process errors (finally-block cleanup)
    51	14. All 8 API client methods are added and call the correct endpoints with correct HTTP methods
    52	15. All integration tests pass
    53	
    54	## Active Pipeline Stages
    55	
    56	`implementation` → `qa` → `security-audit` → `code-review` → `documentation`
    57	
    58	## Estimated Complexity
    59	
    60	High
    61	
    62	## Rationale
    63	
    64	Bulk save avoids partial-state problems and gives users a clear undo path. Staleness detection uses `max(mtime(assignments.json), mtime(local.json))` to catch registry changes (renames, `cc_model` edits) that don't touch assignments but still make persona output stale. `default.json` is excluded because its mtime reflects Git checkout time, not user modification.
    65	
    66	## Rejected Approaches
    67	
    68	- *Per-model instant CRUD:* Requires immediate error handling per operation with no concept of "unsaved changes".
    69	- *Assignment keys as workflow manifest role IDs:* Only cover the 9 ledger roles. Persona `id` from `name-mapping.json` covers all three suites.
    70	
    71	## Notes
    72	
    73	Depends on WP-002 (model-registry module). The rebuild handler follows the subprocess pattern from `orchestrator-manager.ts` but uses a non-detached process. The `handleGetPersonas` endpoint reads whatever `name-mapping.json` currently exists — the full field set (`suite`, `model`, `model_slug`, `cc_model`) is only available after WP-003 is implemented and a build has run. The handler itself needs no changes for WP-003.
    74	
    75	**Code Observations:** `server.ts` uses `matchRoute()` for GET routes (L350+) and inline body-parsing for POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE routes in `handleRequest()` (L1325+). The `api-repos.ts` handler pattern uses pure async functions, Zod validation, and `ApiError` throws — the new handlers should follow this pattern. The API client (`api-client.js`) uses a thin `request(method, path, body)` wrapper — new methods follow the same shape. The `matchRoute` function is exported (L350), suggesting it returns handler functions that are invoked by the main request handler.

   112	/**
   113	 * Returns the current model registry list.
   114	 *
   115	 * Auto-initializes `local.json` from `default.json` if it does not exist
   116	 * (delegates to `readModels()` which handles the initialization).
   117	 */
   118	export async function handleGetModels(): Promise<ModelEntry[]> {
   119	  return readModels();
   120	}
   121	
   122	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   123	// PUT /api/models
   124	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   125	
   126	/**
   127	 * Request body schema for PUT /api/models.
   128	 *
   129	 * Accepts an array of model entries. Entries missing `id` get a fresh UUIDv4
   130	 * assigned before the write is performed.
   131	 *
   132	 * We accept `id` as optional at the schema level so that the handler can
   133	 * auto-assign it. Downstream `writeModels()` requires full `ModelEntry`
   134	 * objects (id required), which is satisfied after UUID assignment.
   135	 */
   136	const SaveModelsBodySchema = z.array(
   137	  z.object({
   138	    id: z.string().uuid().optional(),
   139	    name: z.string().min(1),
   140	    slug: z.string().regex(/^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$/),
   141	    cc_model: z.string().min(1).default('inherit'),
   142	  })
   143	);
   144	
   145	/**
   146	 * Bulk-saves the model registry.
   147	 *
   148	 * - Validates and auto-assigns UUIDv4 to any entry missing `id`.
   149	 * - Delegates validation (slug uniqueness, reserved slug, deletion guard) to
   150	 *   `writeModels()` from the model-registry module.
   151	 * - Returns 409 Conflict when a referenced model would be deleted.
   152	 *
   153	 * @param body - Raw parsed JSON request body.
   154	 */
   155	export async function handleSaveModels(body: unknown): Promise<{
   156	  models: ModelEntry[];
   157	} | {
   158	  conflict: true;
   159	  referencedModels: Array<{
   160	    model: ModelEntry;
   161	    usages: string[];
   162	  }>;
   163	}> {
   164	  const parsed = SaveModelsBodySchema.safeParse(body);
   165	  if (!parsed.success) {
   166	    validationError(
   167	      `Invalid model list: ${parsed.error.issues.map((i) => i.message).join('; ')}`
   168	    );
   169	  }
   170	
   171	  // Auto-assign UUIDv4 to entries missing an id
   172	  const enriched: ModelEntry[] = parsed.data.map((entry) => ({
   173	    id: entry.id ?? randomUUID(),
   174	    name: entry.name,
   175	    slug: entry.slug,
   176	    cc_model: entry.cc_model,
   177	  }));
   178	
   179	  const result = await writeModels(enriched);
   180	
   181	  if (!result.saved) {
   182	    // Deletion blocked — referenced models
   183	    conflictError(
   184	      'One or more models being removed are still referenced in persona model assignments. ' +
   185	        'Use the Replace Model feature to reassign them before removing.',
   186	      result.referencedModels
   187	    );
   188	  }
   189	
   190	  return { models: result.models };
   191	}
   192	
   193	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   194	// POST /api/models/load-defaults
   195	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   196	
   197	/**
   198	 * Merges `default.json` into `local.json`.
   199	 *
   200	 * Existing entries (by UUID) are never overwritten. Slug collisions between
   201	 * new default entries and existing local entries are reported as conflicts but
   202	 * do not block the merge.
   203	 *
   204	 * Returns the post-merge model list and the list of slug-collision conflicts.
   205	 */
   206	export async function handleLoadDefaults(): Promise<{
   207	  models: ModelEntry[];
   208	  conflicts: Array<{
   209	    defaultEntry: ModelEntry;
   210	    localEntry: ModelEntry;
   211	    reason: 'slug_collision';
   212	  }>;
   213	}> {
   214	  return loadDefaults();
   215	}
   216	
   217	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   218	// GET /api/model-assignments
   219	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   220	
   221	/**
   222	 * Staleness check.
   223	 *
   224	 * Returns `true` when `max(mtime(assignments.json), mtime(local.json))` is
   225	 * **greater than** `mtime(name-mapping.json)`, indicating that the user
   226	 * registry or assignments have changed since the last persona build.
   227	 *
   228	 * Staleness rules:
   229	 * - Returns `false` when neither assignments.json nor local.json exist (no
   230	 *   user modifications have been made yet — no build needed).
   231	 * - Returns `false` when only `default.json` exists (mtime reflects Git
   232	 *   checkout time, not user modification; excluded by design).
   233	 * - Returns `false` when name-mapping.json does not exist (no build output to
   234	 *   compare against).
   235	 *
   236	 * @internal
   237	 */
   238	async function computeStale(): Promise<boolean> {
   239	  const registryDir = modelRegistryDir();
   240	
   241	  const [assignmentsMtime, localMtime, nameMappingMtime] = await Promise.all([
   242	    getMtime(join(registryDir, 'assignments.json')),
   243	    getMtime(join(registryDir, 'local.json')),
   244	    getMtime(nameMappingPath()),
   245	  ]);
   246	
   247	  // No user files exist → never stale
   248	  if (assignmentsMtime === null && localMtime === null) {

   250	  }
   251	
   252	  // name-mapping.json doesn't exist → can't compare, not stale
   253	  if (nameMappingMtime === null) {
   254	    return false;
   255	  }
   256	
   257	  // max(mtime(assignments.json), mtime(local.json))
   258	  const userMtimes = [assignmentsMtime, localMtime].filter((m): m is Date => m !== null);
   259	  const maxUserMtime = new Date(Math.max(...userMtimes.map((m) => m.getTime())));
   260	
   261	  return maxUserMtime > nameMappingMtime;
   262	}
   263	
   264	/**
   265	 * Returns the current model assignments enriched with a `stale` boolean.
   266	 */

   275	}
